zoe_docs: Heads-up: we need a tiny migration guide for people using the v1 REST/SDK. v1 /v1/models will be retired; target cutoff 2026-06-01. I'll draft a short page and examples.

anil_eng: quick mapping: v1 `model_id` -> v2 `model`, `prompt` -> `input`. v1 python: `client.generate(model_id='x', prompt='y')` -> v2 python: `client.model_serve.create(model='x', input='y')`. Also response accessor: `resp.text` -> `resp.outputs[0].content`.

cara_pm: add a Dedicated/Private note: we will not auto-redirect self-hosted endpoints. partners need to update gateways.

zoe_docs: will include a 3-line inline diff and two curl snippets (streaming vs non-streaming). Draft curl pair: ```bash
# v1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: ..."}'

# v2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/model-serve -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"Summarize: ..."}'
```

deploy-bot: Please file infra ticket for hosted redirect and console banner feature flag.

anil_eng: I'll add a tiny nginx snippet for partners and a note about streaming JSON deltas.

zoe_docs: checklist for PR: migration doc + curl/python diffs, Dedicated blurb + nginx sample, changelog entry, infra ticket linked, small docs CI smoke test for the curl example. I'll open PR 1410 shortly and tag reviewers.

cara_pm: LGTM, ping me for partner email copy.

zoe_docs: thanks all! :thumbsup:
